purpose: groups, distributions, comparisons and polar summaries
validation_notes: one row per observed experimental unit unless a lower-level observation is explicitly identified

purpose: estimates, contrasts, forest plots and uncertainty
validation_notes: lower <= estimate <= upper; name interval type and level

purpose: relationships, curves and two-variable models
validation_notes: rows must share observation grain; x and y units must be explicit

purpose: time, repeated-measure and hydrological plots
validation_notes: keep actual time spacing and identify repeated subjects; lower/upper must name their interval type when used

purpose: part-to-whole and taxonomic composition
validation_notes: state whether values are counts, proportions or percentages; do not silently close to 100

purpose: long-form heatmaps, association matrices and omics matrices
validation_notes: one unique row-column cell; record scaling and clustering outside the raw input

purpose: ordination scores and biplots
validation_notes: separate site/sample scores from variable arrows; record method, distance and scaling

purpose: alluvial, Sankey and transition plots
validation_notes: one row per path-stage; stages must have an explicit order

purpose: trees, treemaps and nested summaries
validation_notes: parent IDs must exist or be blank roots; values must have one aggregation meaning; optional track columns are plot-ready tip annotations rather than inferred values

purpose: Venn, Euler and UpSet inputs
validation_notes: present must be 0/1 or FALSE/TRUE; retain item identity

purpose: networks and schematic graphs
validation_notes: nodes referenced by edges must be resolvable; network inference is not performed by the renderer

purpose: maps, uncertainty, space-depth and image-like grids
validation_notes: coordinates, CRS, resolution, NoData and support domain must be documented; vector fields require u/v components

purpose: soil horizons and property-depth profiles
validation_notes: top_cm <= bottom_cm; depth increases downward; horizons within a profile are dependent

purpose: remote-sensing or laboratory spectra
validation_notes: state reflectance/absorbance/continuum removal and preprocessing

purpose: model diagnostics, calibration and agreement
validation_notes: values must come from a documented fitted model or validation split

purpose: image, slice and voxel-derived intensity tables
validation_notes: retain original image separately; record calibration, bit depth and all processing

purpose: soil texture and other three-part compositions
validation_notes: parts must use the same basis and close to the declared total within tolerance

purpose: volcano, MA and Manhattan-like result plots
validation_notes: inputs must come from a documented model; thresholds are display parameters, not re-analysis

purpose: MCMC chain ranks and posterior diagnostics
validation_notes: one row per retained draw; identify chains and parameter; diagnose with ESS and R-hat in addition to graphics

purpose: event timelines, Gantt charts and swimmer plots
validation_notes: start <= end; state whether time is elapsed, calendar or age scale

purpose: time-to-event and competing-risk displays
validation_notes: status/event coding, censoring and risk-set definition must be documented

purpose: meta-analysis diagnostics and study-level effect displays
validation_notes: one row per independent study effect; identify effect measure and dependence

purpose: parallel coordinates, Andrews curves, radar and glyphs
validation_notes: one row per sample-variable cell; record centering/scaling and missing-data handling

purpose: Piper, Schoeller, Stiff, Durov and Gibbs diagrams
validation_notes: ions must use a documented molar/equivalent basis; charge-balance checks remain mandatory

purpose: community rank, accumulation, rarefaction and diversity displays
validation_notes: one row per sample-species cell; sampling effort and zero/absence semantics must be explicit

purpose: empirical and fitted variogram displays
validation_notes: lag distance units, estimator, binning, direction and model parameters must be recorded

purpose: ROC, precision-recall, calibration, decision and lift curves
validation_notes: truth/positive class, evaluation split, threshold direction and prevalence must be documented

purpose: PDP, ICE, ALE, feature importance and SHAP displays
validation_notes: values must come from a documented fitted model and background/evaluation sample

purpose: Walter-Lieth and climate summary diagrams
validation_notes: monthly aggregation, station, period and missing-month handling must be explicit

purpose: wind and pollution rose diagrams
validation_notes: direction convention, calm handling, bin edges and normalization must be explicit

purpose: sequence logos by position and symbol
validation_notes: frequencies at each position must close to 1 or information content must be supplied

purpose: genome tracks, segments, junctions and regional association
validation_notes: coordinates, genome build, interval convention and model source must be documented

purpose: categorical longitudinal and state-sequence displays
validation_notes: state definitions, observation spacing and censoring/missing intervals must be documented

purpose: hydrograph, hyetograph, flow-duration and double-mass displays
validation_notes: keep actual time spacing; state discharge and precipitation aggregation and catchment support

purpose: Mantel and fourth-corner matrix-link composites
validation_notes: cell rows require row_id, column_id, value and p_value; link rows require from, to, link_value and link_p; distance, permutation restrictions and multiplicity must be documented
